title: The Burning Sigil
premise: In the city of Vell, where magic is punishable by unmaking, Felix Yarrow survives by stealing memories and selling them as harmless charms. When a dying courier presses a sigil-map into his hands — a map that shows how to unbind King Aldric from the memory-eating entity wearing his crown — Felix becomes hunted by both the Crown's witch-finders and the entity itself. Guided by Sera, a disgraced inquisitor who once burned his mentor, Felix must choose between loyalty to the thieves' guild that raised him (now serving the entity) and the truth of what happened fifteen years ago: that he himself stole the king's memories for coin, opening the door to possession. In the end, Felix returns the stolen memories at the cost of his own past, unbinding the king but erasing everything he was — leaving Sera to remember him for both of them.
about_author: Emrys Almeida is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. They write about memory, guilt, and the small magics people hide in plain sight.

chapters.title: The Weight of Borrowed Years
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. We meet him mid-heist, lifting a widow's grief from her mind and bottling it for sale, establishing the rules of memory-magic in outlawed Vell. A dying stranger collapses into his stall, pressing a burning map into his hands and whispering 'the crown eats.' Emotional beat: reluctant responsibility; Felix wants no part of heroism.

chapters.title: What the Witch-Finders Burn
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Crown witch-finders raid the night market hunting the map's bearer. Felix escapes through the undercity with help from guild contacts, learning the stranger was a royal archivist. Emotional beat: fear hardening into curiosity as he glimpses the map's first sigil — and it matches a memory he sold years ago.

chapters.title: An Inquisitor's Confession
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Disgraced inquisitor Sera Vane tracks Felix not to arrest him but because her own records prove the king changed fifteen years ago. She offers an uneasy alliance, confessing she burned Felix's mentor on false charges. Emotional beat: bitter distrust; two people bound by old sins neither can undo.

chapters.title: The Guild That Sold Its Soul
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Felix seeks sanctuary with Mother Quill, head of the thieves' guild that raised him — and discovers the guild now serves the entity, trading stolen memories upward to feed it. His surrogate brother Dane marks him for death. Emotional beat: betrayal; home revealed as a cage.

chapters.title: Fifteen Years of Stolen Winter
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. In the ruined archive beneath the palace, Sera deciphers the map while Felix confronts the terrible truth: the missing royal memories were the ones he stole as a boy, paid by an anonymous buyer. The entity entered through the gap he made. Emotional beat: guilt crystallizing; the villain's door was opened by the hero's hand.

chapters.title: The Thing Wearing the Crown
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. At a masquerade ball, Felix meets King Aldric — and the entity inside him, which speaks in Felix's own childhood voice, offering to return his mentor alive if he surrenders the map. Felix barely escapes with Sera's help. Emotional beat: temptation; the enemy knows exactly what he longs for.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Mentor
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. The entity's offer proves hollow: Felix finds his mentor's preserved memories in a guild vault, revealing the mentor chose death rather than serve. Dane catches them; Sera takes a wound covering Felix's escape. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into resolve; loyalty to the dead means finishing their work.

chapters.title: The Unbinding Rite
chapters.summary: Felix's POV. Racing the entity's plan to consume the whole city's memories at the coronation anniversary, Felix and Sera assemble the rite — which requires the thief himself to carry the stolen memories back. He learns the price: returning them will erase his own past entirely. Emotional beat: dread and acceptance; he begins saying goodbye without saying why.

chapters.title: Coronation of Ash
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. At the anniversary ceremony, the entity begins feeding on ten thousand minds at once. Felix fights through Dane and the guild to reach the throne; Sera holds the witch-finders off by exposing the entity publicly. Felix begins the unbinding as the thing wearing the crown tears at his identity. Emotional beat: climax; sacrifice chosen freely at last.

chapters.title: The Man Who Forgot Himself
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. The king wakes whole; the entity starves and dissolves; Felix stands blank-eyed amid the ruins of his own history. Sera chooses not to restore him by force, instead staying beside him, telling him their story piece by piece. Final beat: bittersweet hope — justice done outside the law, and a new memory beginning where the old ones ended.
